headings.rules: Use font-black or font-light for radical contrast. tracking-tighter for sizes > 32px. No generic sans.

mono_data.rules: Use exclusively for threat report data, logs, metrics, tags, and overlines. tracking-widest for labels.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 for headers, cards, and floating panels. Never use purely transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise/grain overlay fixed to the viewport (`pointer-events-none opacity-20 z-50 mix-blend-overlay`) to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: Use border-collapse techniques with border-white/10 for Threat Report tables and features sections. The 'Technical Look'.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)] on primary CTAs and critical threat indicators.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-16 for containers. Avoid cramped designs.
layouts.bento_grid: For Services and Gallery: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8, row-span-2 for severe asymmetry.
layouts.hero: 100vh height minimum. Kinetic typography. Use framer-motion for line-by-line masked text reveal. DO NOT center content lazily; opt for optical alignment or dramatic left alignment.
layouts.threat_dashboard: High-density grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with tight gaps (gap-4). Use glass cards. Include live stats counters.
layouts.admin_panel: Cardless, pure structural layouts. Dense information, JetBrains Mono font for inputs.

motion.scrolling: MUST USE '@studio-freight/react-lenis' for smooth momentum scrolling across the entire site.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion: <motion.div> with initial={{ y: 40, opacity: 0 }} whileInView={{ y: 0, opacity: 1 }} viewport={{ once: true }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards: -translate-y-2 with glowing border. Button hovers: expand letter-spacing slightly.

components_instructions.buttons: Sharp rectangular with 1px border. On hover, background fills with accent color (cyan) and text flips to black. Use Framer Motion for tap states.
components_instructions.tabs: Custom tab navigation. Strip default Shadcn backgrounds. Use JetBrains Mono, underline active state, glowing text.
components_instructions.threat_card: Includes MITRE ATT&CK chain steps in micro-tags, process tree visualization (framer-motion nodes), and severity badge.
components_instructions.editorial_marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Slow speed. Font: JetBrains Mono uppercase, wide tracking.
components_instructions.forms: Admin panel and forms must use Shadcn customized inputs, but strip generic 'Vercel' looks.
components_instructions.file_extension: Build all components as .jsx/.js. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts) as per environment rules.

media.hero_3d: Use react-force-graph-3d or TSParticles for an abstract network mesh in the hero background.

images.description: Abstract neon nodes for threat report background
Hacker terminal for Cyber Security Services

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Ensure to use data-testid on all icons and interactive elements.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has background gradients (e.g., from-black/80 to-transparent) to maintain APCA readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='contact-email').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Do not use generic Inter font. Follow the typography guide exactly.
Implement using .js and .jsx files. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx/.ts).
